clue.text: Scotsman Eliza would naturally confuse with a Hebridean, say?

definitions.text: Scotsman Eliza would naturally confuse with a Hebridean, say?

parts.words: Scotsman Eliza would naturally confuse with a Hebridean, say?
parts.note: Eliza Doolittle, the Cockney flower girl of Pygmalion, drops her aitches, so a man from the Scottish mountains in her mouth comes out sounding like 'eye-lander', an island dweller such as a Hebridean

explanation.surface: A Scotsman whom a Cockney girl would mix up with someone from the Western Isles.
explanation.walkthrough: Eliza Doolittle (Shaw's Pygmalion, the musical My Fair Lady) speaks Cockney and drops every H. The Hebrides are islands off western Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: The Scottish mountain region's inhabitants are a classic type of Scotsman.

clue.text: In ancient myth she became a goddess

indicators.note: the goddess sits in the words she became, across the word break

explanation.surface: A mythical woman who was deified.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' signals the hidden run in 'sHE BEcame'.
explanation.definitionFit: Greek goddess of youth, cupbearer to the gods.

clue.text: Perhaps no one's bidding to make this stew

definitions.meaning: in bridge, a redeal of the cards after everyone passes, with nobody bidding
a Hungarian meat stew with paprika

explanation.definitionFit: A bridge term for redealing when all pass; also a paprika-spiced Hungarian dish.

clue.text: Winding trail by inn, he constructed

indicators.note: the letters are built up into a new shape, as a house is constructed

explanation.surface: A twisting path laid out by the innkeeper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'constructed' rearranges TRAILBYINNHE.
explanation.definitionFit: Like a maze, full of twists and turns.

clue.text: Visionary's first love is to become 'countryman countryman

indicators.note: the first O (love, zero in tennis) in the synonym is to be changed into an A

parts.note: notional means imaginary or visionary

explanation.surface: A dreamer's first love is to become a rustic.
explanation.walkthrough: Love is O (zero in tennis); NOTIONAL turns its first O into A.
explanation.definitionFit: A citizen of a particular country is one of its nationals.

clue.text: English girl detailed to make a cake

indicators.note: de-tailed means having its tail, the final letter, cut off

parts.note: Claire is a girl's name

explanation.surface: An English girl assigned to bake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailed' (de-tailed) drops the last E from CLAIRE.
explanation.definitionFit: A long choux pastry filled with cream and topped with chocolate.

clue.text: This may lead us to the light

definitions.text: This may lead us to the light

parts.words: This may lead us to the light
parts.note: in crosswords a 'light' is a grid entry, and what leads a solver to fill one is the printed hint; the surface suggests guidance towards spiritual illumination

explanation.surface: Something that guides us out of darkness into daylight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Light' is crossword jargon for an answer space in the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: A crossword hint is what points the solver towards each grid entry.

clue.text: Book for"'one prisoner held under. Roman law

indicators.note: in a down clue, the pieces held below come after the law in the entry

parts.note: lex is Latin for law
I is the Roman numeral one
con is short for convict

explanation.surface: A book about a convict jailed under Roman law.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, 'held under' places I and CON below LEX.
explanation.definitionFit: A dictionary or word list is a type of reference book.

clue.text: The whole lot, say, with exceedingly flimsy contents

indicators.note: the two adjectives are the contents placed inside the abbreviation for say

parts.note: e.g. means for example, 'say'
very means exceedingly
thin means flimsy

explanation.surface: All of it, for instance, with very insubstantial filling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contents' puts VERY THIN inside EG.
explanation.definitionFit: All things, the entirety.

clue.text: University sportsman with courage to be a policeman

parts.note: a Blue is someone who has represented Oxford or Cambridge at a sport
bottle is British slang for nerve or courage

explanation.surface: A college athlete with nerve enough to join the police.
explanation.walkthrough: A Blue is an Oxford or Cambridge sporting representative; 'bottle' is British slang for courage.
explanation.definitionFit: Old British slang for a police officer, from the blue uniform.

clue.text: Learner breaks tool making a spindle

indicators.note: the learner's letter breaks into the tool, splitting it open

parts.note: an axe is a chopping tool
L is the learner-driver plate letter

explanation.surface: A trainee snaps a tool and produces a rod.
explanation.definitionFit: A rod on which a wheel turns is a kind of spindle.

clue.text: Permissiveness of stage show? No, it's very narrow

indicators.note: permissiveness of the show means the show's permissiveness, so the show comes first

parts.note: Hair is the 1960s rock musical, here with possessive 's
breadth can mean broad-mindedness or liberality

explanation.surface: Asking whether a musical is liberal, and answering that it is extremely tight.
explanation.walkthrough: Hair was a famously permissive 1960s musical; 'breadth' is tolerance. Used attributively, as in a narrow escape, the answer means very narrow.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny margin, the width of one strand, as in a close shave.

clue.text: Just like a Scottish Isle

definitions.meaning: ... Isle is one of the Shetland islands, lending its name to a knitting pattern

explanation.definitionFit: Equitable treatment is just; and a Shetland island, famous for patterned knitwear, shares this name.

clue.text: Go charily, reshuffling the Government

indicators.note: a cabinet reshuffle rearranges ministers, so here the letters of the first two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Advice to tread carefully while the cabinet is being rearranged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reshuffling' rearranges GOCHARILY.
explanation.definitionFit: Rule by a small elite is a form of government.

clue.text: Got on without vision, being canny.

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, the getting-on word surrounding vision

parts.note: fared means got on or managed
sight is vision

explanation.surface: Managed without being able to see, yet shrewd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside here: FARED goes around SIGHT. The surface pushes the 'lacking' sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrewd and prudent, with an eye to the future.

clue.text: A capital fellow, Demosthenes!

definitions.meaning: a man from the capital of Greece
the great orator of ancient Greece came from that city

explanation.surface: Hailing the orator Demosthenes as a splendid chap.
explanation.definitionFit: A citizen of the Greek capital; Demosthenes was one such orator.

clue.text: Yank architect honoured

parts.note: Sir Christopher Wren designed St Paul's Cathedral
CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British honour

explanation.surface: An American architect receives an honour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yank' looks like an American; it is the verb meaning pull sharply.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden violent pull or twist is a yank.

clue.text: It takes an early riser to encourage this flower

parts.note: a lark is someone who gets up early
to spur is to encourage

explanation.surface: Only an early bird can egg this bloom on.
explanation.definitionFit: A delphinium-like plant with spurred blue flowers.

clue.text: Hunted species, according to some

indicators.note: some speakers, those who do not sound the R, pronounce the word for species exactly like the answer

parts.note: a sort is a kind or species

explanation.surface: Endangered creatures, in some people's account, were hunted.
explanation.walkthrough: In non-rhotic English, SORT and SOUGHT sound identical.
explanation.definitionFit: Searched for or pursued is the past tense of seek.

clue.text: Reportedly you' listen with difficulty to this instrument

indicators.note: what is reported is heard, so the pronoun becomes a letter with the same sound

parts.note: the letter U sounds like you

indicators.note: the word listen is rearranged with effort

explanation.surface: Apparently you struggle to hear through this device.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with difficulty' rearranges LISTEN to TENSIL after U.
explanation.definitionFit: A tool or implement, especially in a kitchen.

clue.text: Horseman seen outside many a a tower

indicators.note: the horse and man stand outside, around the figure for many

parts.note: a Barb is a North African breed of horse, and Ian a man's name
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, i.e. many

explanation.surface: A rider spotted outside a fortification.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Horseman' splits into BARB (horse) and IAN (man), which go around C.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortified outpost or gate tower guarding a castle or city.

clue.text: Violin factory where more can undergo renovation

indicators.note: being renovated, the letters are rebuilt into a new order

explanation.surface: A violin works where more can be restored.
explanation.walkthrough: 'undergo renovation' rearranges MORECAN. The Italian city was home to Stradivari and Amati.
explanation.definitionFit: The Lombardy city famous as the home of Stradivari's violin workshop.

clue.text: Disappear, rather like a road vehicle?

parts.note: a van is a road vehicle
the suffix -ish means somewhat like

explanation.surface: Asking whether disappearing is somewhat like a lorry.
explanation.definitionFit: To vanish is to go out of sight.

clue.text: . Fresh support for an old American banknote

parts.note: green means new or fresh
to back is to support

explanation.surface: New backing for an old US dollar bill.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for a US dollar bill, from the colour of its reverse side.

clue.text: Former PM's oriental study.

parts.note: E stands for east, the oriental direction
a den is a private study room

explanation.surface: A former prime minister's Far Eastern research.
explanation.walkthrough: Anthony Eden was UK prime minister 1955-57; 's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Anthony Eden was a British prime minister in the 1950s.

clue.text: The current conductor's star role

definitions.meaning: a wire carrying electric current; 's stands for is
the principal part in a play

explanation.definitionFit: An electric cable conducts current; the principal acting part.

clue.text: Series of questions makes us irritable before the end

indicators.note: stopping before the end means the final letter of the synonym is cut off

parts.note: testy means irritable

explanation.surface: An exam makes us cross until it is over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'before the end' drops Y from TESTY.
explanation.definitionFit: An exam is a set of questions.

clue.text: Circus provides joint capital to adopt small herd of seals

indicators.note: the joint and capital take in the herd between them, as a family adopts a child

parts.note: the hip is a joint
Rome is the Italian capital
a pod is a group of seals or whales

explanation.surface: A circus offers a shared capital to take in a few seals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to adopt' puts POD between HIP and ROME.
explanation.definitionFit: An arena for circus acts or variety shows, from the ancient horse-racing stadium.

clue.text: Payment a king left for a' pretty, woman

indicators.note: left means departed, so the letters for a king go away

parts.note: a dollar is a unit of payment
A plus R, the abbreviation for Rex, king

explanation.surface: A king leaves money for an attractive woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' removes A and R (Rex, king) from DOLLAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Dated slang for an attractive young woman.

clue.text: Healthy wartime leader close to an elegiac scene

indicators.note: being healthy means not ill, so the illness is removed from the leader's name

parts.note: Winston Churchill led Britain in the Second World War
a close is an enclosed yard, as in a cathedral close

explanation.surface: A fit war leader stands near a mournful scene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Healthy' removes ILL. The scene is Gray's 'Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard'.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Gray's famous elegy is set in a country burial ground beside a church.
